title: Ontario Driver's Licence Exchange Requirements
summary: New Ontario residents must exchange out-of-province licences within 60 days of moving. Proof of identity, residency, and driving history required.
raw_content: If you are moving to Ontario from another Canadian province or eligible international jurisdiction (e.g. UK, USA, Australia), you must exchange your licence within 60 days. You need to visit a DriveTest centre with proof of identity and current Ontario residency.

title: UK NHS GP Surgery Registration Process
summary: Anyone in England can register with a GP surgery for free. No proof of address or immigration status is legally required to register.
raw_content: To register with an NHS GP surgery in England, complete the GMS1 form or register online. GP surgeries cannot turn you away because you do not have proof of address or ID.

title: UK Council Tax Liability & Registration
summary: Occupiers of domestic properties in the UK must register for Council Tax with the local borough council within 14 days of moving in.
raw_content: Council tax pays for local services. Full-time students and single occupants are eligible for discounts (e.g., 25% single person discount).

title: Singapore MOM Employment Pass & Card Registration
summary: EP pass holders must register biometric details at the Employment Pass Services Centre (EPSC) within 2 weeks of pass issuance.
raw_content: Upon arrival in Singapore under an EP Notification Letter, the candidate must schedule an appointment at EPSC to capture fingerprints and photo for the physical pass card.

title: California DMV New Resident Driver License Rule
summary: New California residents must obtain a CA Driver's License within 10 days of establishing residency.
raw_content: When you establish California residency (e.g., gain employment, pay resident tuition, file tax returns), you must apply for a CA driver's license at a local DMV within 10 days.

title: Portugal NIF (Número de Identificação Fiscal) Acquisition
summary: NIF is mandatory for renting property, opening a bank account, or subscribing to utilities in Portugal.
raw_content: O NIF é o número de identificação fiscal em Portugal. Qualquer pessoa residente ou não residente necessita do NIF para efetuar transações financeiras, abrir conta bancária ou assinar contrato de arrendamento.
